items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I got to know the Asuntos when I started working with the Basin Street Six... The Asuntos and Betty and all of the, uh, the folks in Frank's band, they were much younger than most of the rest of the bands on Bourbon Street at that time.

ctx.x: And were their sonos that much older than you?

Well, Frank was about two years older than I was. Mm-hmm. Um, and Freddie was still, I think Freddie was maybe four or five years older than Frank. Uh, I'm not certain, I, uh, I, I got to know the Asuntos when I started working with the Basin Street Six, and I was, uh, about 19, and they were working down the street at the famous door. And we, you know, got to know each other again. The Asuntos and Betty and all of the, uh, the folks in Frank's band, they were much younger than most of the rest of the bands on…
That gave you a special bond or not?
